title: World Accelerator
description: Adds a World Accelerator block that increases Random and Block entity tick rates.
body:
# World Accelerator

Adds a World Accelerator block that increases [Random tick](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Tick#Random_tick) and [Block entity tick](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Block_entity) rates.

## Features

- Increases [Random tick](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Tick#Random_tick) and [Block entity tick](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Block_entity) rates proportionally to redstone signal strength. By default, the World Accelerator is disabled (signal strength `0`) and the maximum speed is `15`.
- Mobs cannot spawn on top of the World Accelerator.
- Accelerates in a 3x3x3 radius, e.g. one block on each side and diagonal.

## Crafting

![Crafting recipe for one World Accelerator. In order, from top left to bottom right: Emerald, Eye of Ender, Emerald, Obsidian, Nether Star, Obsidian, Obsidian, Obsidian, Obsidian.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0d679693512e77f28a65b27e08533d87d89b9725.png)

## Config

The following options are available through the config:

- **Enable crafting**: If `false`, disables crafting recipe.
- **Enable particles**: If `false`, disables particles when powered.
